notes.coordinates: Latitude/longitude derived from official NZTM coordinates in the EA Network Supply Points table. Representative GXP codes use clearly labelled site-level proxies from the same named substation. Nodes without verified coordinates are not plotted on the map.
notes.means: Daily mean nodal price in NZD/MWh; null means the node had no published price for that date.
notes.status: dateStatus is Final or Interim for each published trading day.
notes.volatility7d: Sample standard deviation of daily mean prices across the last 7 published dates.
